name: GE Profile™ Opal™ Gray/Stainless Steel Mini Side Tank
shortDescription: Enjoy less frequent fill-ups thanks to a 0.5 Gal side tank water reservoir that comes included with your Opal.
metaTitle: GE Profile™ Opal™ Gray/Stainless Steel Mini Side Tank
metaDescription: Enjoy less frequent fill-ups thanks to a 0.5 Gal side tank water reservoir that comes included with your Opal.

features.text: Using the ice maker side tank produces 2x more ice than using the reservoir alone, which also helps reduce water refills during high demand
Easy to use, simply fill when the ice is getting low, then flip into the home base, and soon you'll be enjoying more delicious nugget ice
The side tank easily detaches, which helps make cleaning quick and simple
